text:
```yaml
name: Validate PR

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # The shared composite action lives in the getsentry/github-workflows
      # repository under .github/actions/validate-pr.  The action is
      # published as a composite action and can be referenced by its
      # tag.  The latest stable tag is v0.1.0.
      - name: Run shared validate-pr action
        uses: getsentry/github-workflows/.github/actions/validate-pr@v0.1.0
        with:
          skip-changelog: true
          enforce-draft: true
```
